title: WHEN GOD SAYS THE TIME HAS COME

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place. "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle. This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you." - Deut 2:23-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After all the years of passing by peaceably, the moment finally came for Israel to begin taking possession of the land God was giving them. God's word to cross the Arnon Gorge and engage Sihon marks the turning point: "See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite." Notice the past tense — "I have given." Before a single battle was fought, God spoke of the victory as already accomplished. This was the language of faith: God had determined the outcome, and Israel was to act on His promise.

There is a lesson here about how God works. He often gives us the promise before we see the fulfilment, calling us to step forward in faith on the strength of His word. Israel had to cross the gorge and engage the enemy, but they did so knowing God had already secured the outcome. Their obedience was a response to His promise, not an attempt to earn it.

God also declared that He would go before them, putting fear of them into the surrounding nations. The victory would not ultimately rest on Israel's strength but on God's power working ahead of them. He was preparing the way, softening the ground, going before His people into the battle.

This is how God so often leads us into what He has called us to. He gives the promise, He goes before us, and He calls us to step forward in trusting obedience. We do not advance in our own strength but in the confidence that God has already gone ahead. Whatever "Arnon Gorge" God is calling you to cross, remember: the One who calls you has gone before you, and in Christ every promise of God is yes (2 Cor 1:20). Step forward in faith.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where is God calling you to step forward in faith on the strength of His promise?
2. How does knowing God goes before you give you courage?
3. What does it mean to act in trusting obedience rather than earning God's favour?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You give the promise and go before me into every battle. Help me to step forward in trusting obedience, confident that You have already secured the outcome and that every promise is yes in Christ. Amen.
